title: A2A Task Delegation
description: Task unit for A2A 1.0 delegation (submit, stream, get, cancel). Extends pack delegation with full lifecycle.

task_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4 recommended for Antigravity).

delegator.description: Role or agent identity of the delegating agent.

assignee_role.description: Required role of the receiving agent.

assignee_agent_card.description: Optional URI or registry key to worker Agent Card.

task_description.description: Clear, self-contained description of the work to perform.

input_data.description: All context the assignee needs. Must be self-contained.

output_schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema the result must conform to.

success_criteria.description: Conditions that must be true for the task to be considered complete.

constraints.description: Boundaries the assignee must not exceed.

risk_tier.description: Level of rigor required for this task.

interaction_mode.description: sync=blocking invoke; stream=SSE progress; push=webhook on completion.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum task execution duration in milliseconds (supersedes timeout_minutes).

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time allowed for task completion in minutes (legacy fallback).

retry_policy.description: Resilient retry strategy with exponential backoff and jitter for transient task failures.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts before marking the task failed.

backoff_factor.description: Multiplier for exponential backoff between retries.

max_interval_ms.description: Maximum delay ceiling between retries in milliseconds.

retryable_errors.description: Error codes or failure categories eligible for retry.

jitter.description: Whether or which jitter strategy to apply (boolean or enum ['none', 'full', 'equal']).

parent_task_id.description: Parent task for scatter-gather or phased graphs.

examples.task_description: Implement COD store routing in NewLogicAutoAssign.php per slice-01 of technical-delivery-plan 2026-06-12-change-store-order-cod.
success_criteria: Implementation result validates against its contract.
